title: Encoded computation step check
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet; let $x$ be a Boolean input, $s$ a natural number, and $w,w'$ Boolean lists. The predicate requires that $w$ is a valid check for input length $|x|$ and parameter $s$, that $|w'|=W(N)(2s+1)+w_P(|x|)+1$, and that the entry of $w'$ at index $W(N)(2s+1)+w_P(|x|)$ is true. It also requires a Boolean choice $b$ such that the encoded input-head position in the indicated segment of $w'$ equals the position obtained by moving the position encoded in the corresponding segment of $w$ according to the input-head movement determined from the scan of $w$, the input symbol at that position, and $b$; finally, the indicated scan of the two transition results on the prefixes of $w$ and $w'$ must report true completion.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean input alphabet
A Boolean choice $b$ witnessing the required conditions
caveat: Several predicates and encoding functions in the statement are not defined in the supplied material, so the validity and completion conditions cannot be given a more explicit mathematical interpretation.
